body: Forward test of the sector cycle/lead indicator method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.30 (naive base rate 0.40) that: Tata Power reports ≥2.5 GW of renewable capacity added (commissioned) in FY27. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (11-Nov-2026): CEO Praveer Sinha: 'we have missed the targets in first and second quarter, but many of the projects are now ready. The evacuation lines which were delayed, we are expecting some of them to come by December or January… this year target is 2.5 GW of capacity addition, and we will be able to meet that.' NTPC's call the same month also cites transmission (evacuation) delays leaving ~1.5 GW stranded (sector-wide lead indicator). Reasoning: Lead indicator: transmission/evacuation delays are sector-wide and outside the developer's control; H1 shortfall means H2 must carry most of 2.5 GW. Promise reaffirmation after two misses is weak evidence. Resolution: YES if Tata Power's Q4 FY27 results presentation/press release states renewable (utility-scale + group captive, as Tata Power itself counts it) capacity commissioned/added during FY27 ≥2.5 GW (2,500 MW). Rooftop/distributed solar excluded unless Tata Power includes it in the same 2.5 GW target definition. Source: Tata Power Q4 FY27 investor presentation / press release. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: Indian RE developers meet annual commissioning targets after a behind-plan H1 roughly 40% of the time.

title: Paper call: Tata Power reports ≥2.5 GW of renewable capacity added (commissioned) in FY27
